name: EkGuru global content schema

idRules.stable: content IDs never change once published; a rename adds an alias, not a new id
idRules.unique: IDs are globally unique; the registry validator rejects duplicates

fields.source_language: ISO 639-1 of the learner's language, or 'en' default. Not used to fork URLs — it is metadata.
fields.target_language: ISO 639-1 of the language being learned. Drives /learn/<target>/ routing when content exists.

routingRules: /learn/<target-language>/  exists only when that language has PRODUCTION content
level/topic/goal dirs exist only where real content exists (no empty dirs, no thin pages)
country and source-language context is metadata + contextual modules, never URL multiplication
hreflang only between equivalent pages; dashboards/review/private state are noindex
